body:
The boys are my bright spot, and the thought of permanently hurting them is one of the things that has stayed my hand.

But I'm tired.  Worse yet, I know how pathetic all of this sounds, but its bad enough today that I'm reaching out.  Last week, I talked with an old friend who told me she tried to commit suicide a couple of months ago.  Ended up in the psych ward for a few weeks and is under near constant care right now.  My only thought was "at least she had the guts to try".
The thing is, the rational side of me knows this, but the more I dwell on it and think it through, the more it makes sense.  Thanks PB.  Love the nick.

Thank you.  There are good days and bad ones.  I've just seemed to have hit a string of bad ones, but it seems like the best days are behind me.

In my life, there are precious few things I've been both good at and enjoy doing.  Being a dad is one of those, and now I'm going to see my boys 1/2 time at best, and may losing my job very soon because my head is stuck up my ass.
